newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan gov't okays $256 mln for debt spending.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan gov't okays $256 mln for debt spending.

text.p: The Venezuelan government approved an extra spending request of 121.4 billion bolivars ($256 million) Wednesday to be spent on foreign and domestic debt, Information Minister Fernando Egana said.
The debt spending request, which must be approved by Congress, forms part of a 149 billion ($314 million) extra spending credit, Egana told reporters after the weekly meeting of cabinet ministers.
Egana did not specify what kind of debt the spending would be used to pay.
The remaining 27.6 billion bolivars ($48 million) will go towards spending in Venezuela's 22 states, Egana added.
"These two credits show the government's commitment to set aside important revenues to service and reduce the amount of the foreign public debt as a proportion of the national budget," he said.
